name: Kaneda Wabisuke
source:
Wabisuke is the captain of the school's soccer club, and also (reluctantly) becomes a member of the Forbidden Date Club after a series of events. He is Nazuna's older brother, and totally adores her; being an obvious siscon. They share a different last name because of a family tradition- the daughters get the mother's last name and the sons get the father's last name. 

Aside from his exceptional soccer skills and good looks, Wabisuke is positive, kind and caring, making him popular amongst many girls. Wabisuke is very reliable when one's in a bind, and he often comes to Nazuna's rescue. He's always been overprotective when it comes to Nazuna, but it seems to worsen when they both get involved with the date club...
